## Detailed Skill Matrix

### 1. Frontend Development
- **Next.js**: Server Components, App Router, Route Handlers, Metadata API, Dynamic Import, SEO & Performance Optimization.
- **React**: Functional Components, Hooks, Context API, Custom Hooks, Concurrent Mode features.
- **TypeScript**: Strict Type Safety, Interfaces, Generics, Component Prop Typing.
- **UI & Styling**: Tailwind CSS, CSS Grid/Flexbox, Custom Design Systems, Responsive Layouts, Dark Mode Aesthetics.

### 2. Creative Development & Motion
- **Three.js & React Three Fiber**: 3D Canvas, Shaders, Mesh Manipulations, Orbit Controls, Custom Render Loops.
- **GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform)**: ScrollTrigger, Timeline Orchestration, Micro-interactions, Morphing SVG, Complex Sequence Animation.
- **Framer Motion**: Gesture Animations, Layout Animations, AnimatePresence, Scroll-driven Motion.
- **Lenis**: Smooth scrolling engine integration.

### 4. AI & Machine Learning
- **Model Fine-Tuning**: PyTorch DDP, FlashAttention-2, QLoRA, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, TRL.
- **Inference Engines & Serving**: vLLM, PagedAttention, FastAPI streaming endpoints (SSE), Google Colab GPU runtimes.
- **AI Architectures**: Fine-tuning open-source LLMs (Qwen2.5-Coder), dataset curation & validation, ChatML formatting, Chain-of-Thought prompts.

## Featured Engineering Projects

### 1. RAIZEN 7.61B — Enterprise AI Coding Intelligence & Studio
- **Architecture**: 7.61 Billion Parameter coding foundation model fine-tuned from `Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct` on 4× NVIDIA A10G GPUs (`g5.12xlarge`).
- **Dataset**: 15,000 curated multi-turn ChatML Golden Dataset records across 5 core pillars (Full-stack architecture, algorithms, security refactoring, multi-file engineering, and chain-of-thought reasoning).
- **Studio Interface**: Next.js 14 Swiss-precision developer interface featuring real-time SSE token streaming, Chat Studio, Model Explorer, and local Snippet Vault.
- **Links**: [Hugging Face Model](https://huggingface.co/shawaz03/RAIZEN) | [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/shawaz03/N-14)

### 2. Campus Rides — Student Mobility Platform
- **Architecture**: Full-stack Next.js and Supabase application connecting campus student riders with drivers.
- **Features**: Interactive Maplibre GL vector mapping, real-time geolocation tracking, React Query query-cache syncing, and student SOS alerts.
- **Links**: [Live Application](https://campusrides-nu.vercel.app/) | [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/shawaz03/Campus-rides)
